profile.headline: Associate Software Engineer II | Problem Solver
profile.summary:
As an engineer, I bring a strong foundation in ownership, communication, and problem-solving to every project I take on. Over the past two years in software development, I’ve strengthened my ability to build reliable, maintainable solutions while collaborating closely with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.

I’ve worked across TypeScript-based UI component development and AI-driven engineering initiatives, including agentic workflows for code generation and contextual documentation experiences integrated into developer tooling. I enjoy solving complex problems, improving developer experience, and building systems that make teams more efficient.

I take pride in being adaptable, detail-oriented, and consistently learning — whether that means refining component APIs, improving system design, or exploring new approaches to applied AI. I’m excited to keep growing as an engineer and to contribute to teams building thoughtful, high-impact software.
